trial_title: Evaluation of the Accuracy of the Vessel Navigator Tool for Catheterization of Supra-aortic Vessels - ARCHIBALD
brief_summary: This study compares the accuracy of fusion imaging (Fusion Roadmap) versus real-time X-ray imaging (Roadmap) during catheterization of supra-aortic trunks of in patients with aneurysms or arteriovenous malformations.

eligibility_table.criterion: Preoperative assessment or systematic follow-up of aneurysms or arteriovenous malformations, arterial cervical or intracranial stenosis, head and neck vascular tumors.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has an arteriovenous malformation (AVM), which qualifies her for preoperative assessment or systematic follow-up as per the inclusion criterion.
